pinned_at: 2026-11-21, before the 2027 season and before any 2027 data exists
model: cfb-structural-v7 (the artifact frozen at the start of 2027 week 0; any refit during the season is a new version and restarts the count)

comparators.consensus_only: fair = the timestamped DraftKings anchor at decision time (the cfb-structural-v6.2 w = 1 arm); same pick rule, same asks
comparators.opener: DraftKings opening line from the forward ESPN pregame capture (first observed record per event)

scope: FBS-involved games from 2027 week 0 through the last bowl; Flat tier only; picks never routed to Main or the auto-buyer
pick_rule: max-edge side per market (moneyline, spread, total) against the captured Polymarket executable ask; emit only when fair - ask > 0; one pick per event-market (the first decision-time row of the day)

primary.metric: CLV in probability points = close_prob(same contract, same side) - decision-time ask
primary.close: last captured Polymarket book for the contract with observed_at in [kickoff - 90 min, kickoff), market OPEN, never a post-resolution or post-kickoff price; mid = (best bid + best ask) / 2 when both sides exist, else the ask
primary.secondary_close: DraftKings close from the forward pregame capture (last record before kickoff): line CLV in points signed toward the pick, reported alongside
primary.min_close_coverage: valid close for >= 70% of picks; below that the gate is INSUFFICIENT_DATA (capture problem, not a model verdict)
primary.pass: mean CLV > 0 with the date-clustered bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 11) 95% CI low > 0, AND mean CLV(v7) >= mean CLV(consensus_only) - 0.25 probability points

secondary.mae_vs_opener: paired margin MAE delta (v7 - DraftKings opener) on games with a captured opener (n >= 400); passes if the 95% CI high < 0
secondary.orthogonalised_slope: coefficient on (v7 - close) in OLS of (result - close) on [1, close, v7 - close], spreads and totals separately, ESPN/DraftKings pre-kickoff close; passes if the date-clustered 95% CI low > 0 with n >= 600

tertiary.metric: moneyline Brier and log loss, v7 vs v5 and vs consensus_only, all FBS-involved games
tertiary.pass: Brier delta (v7 - v5) <= +0.001 and log loss delta <= +0.003

decision.PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE: primary pass AND secondary pass AND tertiary pass; the operator then decides via `python -m model_prediction.model_promotion promote` (never automatic)
decision.FAIL: primary fail, OR (primary not pass and both secondaries' point estimates on the wrong side)
decision.CONTINUE: anything else; the evaluation carries into 2028 with the same thresholds and a fresh count
decision.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: fewer than 300 picks with a valid close, or close coverage below 70%, at the end of the 2027 bowls

context.ats_power: a 53% ATS rate needs about 1,100 bets to separate from 50%; CLV converges faster, so it is primary
context.holdout_history: every ESPN lined window 2017-2025 and the 2024-11-15+ holdout were read before (v5/v6/v6.1/v6.2/v7); 2027 is the first clean market-relative test
context.v5: v5 keeps serving and picking throughout; nothing is disabled

reporting: monthly descriptive tables are allowed and non-binding; the verdict is computed once, after the last 2027 bowl, from this file (sha256 recorded in docs/CFB_V7_2027_GATE.md and the quick-261121-v7 SUMMARY)
